messages:
Maria: quick async check — where are we on the sprint bridge work for continuous batching + kv warmup? I need a short status for tomorrow's cross-team review.

Devin: PR #4872 is merged (kernel: batching coord). Basic perf looks good on microbenchmarks. Still validating end-to-end with kv warmup enabled.

Sasha: infra rolled a staging canary with the new warmup flag yesterday. Saw steady 12% p90 latency reduction on small-seq traffic but a slight tail bump on long-seq.

Leo: can you confirm ownership for the follow-ups? Who owns the tail regression triage + rollback policy?

Devin: I'll own the tail regression triage (kernel). If we need fallback behavior, Anya + ops can set a staged rollback route while we root-cause.

Anya: noted. ops will provision a fallback route and a short SLA for the canary today. Ops-bot: deploy scheduled for 12:30 UTC to staging. :white_check_mark:

Maria: timeline? are we still on track for the mid-sprint milestone (end of week) for initial rollout to dedicated?

Devin: timeline stands, but blockers: (1) kv eviction heuristics need a small tweak to avoid double-warm paths, (2) a kernel scheduling race under high conc. Both are small, targeted. Expect fixes by EOD.

Sasha: dependency callout — the infra change that adds the `warmup_window_ms` flag to the autoscaler needs a minor schema bump in config service (PR #4921). That blocks Dedicated rollout until merged.

Maria: OK, Devin + Sasha please list exact PRs/deps in the handoff doc. I'll include them in the cross-team review.

Devin: short checklist I'm tracking:
- merged: kernel batching coord (PR #4872)
- in review: kv eviction fix (PR #4930)
- infra schema bump (PR #4921)
- perf test script updated: `./scripts/load_test --seq 512 --warmup true`

Sasha: infra action items: schema bump + staging canary routing + metric alert tweak for kv-cache-miss-rate. I'll tag infra owners in PR.

Leo: product note — we need to ensure canary is restricted to internal beta customers only. Anya, can ops ensure routing/filtering for that?

Anya: yes, ops will add header-based routing to limit canary to beta tenants. Will document the exact header and add tests.

Maria: any perf numbers we can share now? short bullets only please.

Devin: staging microbench: throughput +7%, p99 unchanged, p90 -12% on small seq. End-to-end staging with kv warmup: p90 -8%, but p99 +5% on long seq.

Sasha: infra metrics: cache fill rate improved, avg KV miss reduced ~18%. Observability note: add a dashboard showing miss-rate vs. request-seq-length.

Maria: action owners summary for handoff doc (I'll paste into the review doc):
- Devin: kernel triage + fix for scheduling race, PR #4930 (own)
- Sasha: infra schema bump PR #4921 + routing for canary (own)
- Anya: ops canary routing + rollback playbook (own)
- Maria: compile cross-team slide + milestone ask
- Leo: product constraints for canary (internal beta only)

Devin: pinging @Sasha on the eviction edge-case repro logs I dropped in #kernel-debug — need a quick review before I push the fix.

Sasha: saw them, left a short note. Looks like eviction timing + async prefetch overlap. I'll sketch a mitigation tomorrow morning.

Maria: last check — do we need to delay the dedicated rollout if p99 stays +5% on long seq? Thoughts?

Leo: prefer a short mitigation first (eviction tweak) and then a limited dedicated rollout (low-percentage traffic). Product ok with slow ramp if ops can guard it.

Anya: ops can gate by tenant + percent. We'll set an automated rollback if p99 exceeds baseline +4% for 10m.

Devin: fine. I'll get the PR for the eviction tweak up in 2 hours and start a canary run after infra merges schema bump.

Maria: thanks. I'll assemble the slide with the checklist and send to the cross-team reviewers before 10:00 UTC. Please post PR links and a 2-line summary in this thread when ready.

ops-bot: reminder — staging deploy at 12:30 UTC, status updates will appear in #deploys.

Devin: posting PR links: #4930 (eviction tweak), #4921 (infra schema), #4872 (merged batching). Brief: eviction tweak reduces double-warm by splitting prefetch windows; infra schema exposes warmup_window_ms flag.

Sasha: added dashboard ticket TKT-2047 to track miss-rate vs seq.

Maria: perfect — that's all for now. I'll follow up if reviewers ask for more detail. :rocket:
